# $top is bounded 1–200, and the API's own hint says so

**Claim.** A `$top` outside 1–200 is refused with INVALID_PARAMETER, and the refusal states the real bounds — maximum 200 in the text, default 50 in the hint — contradicting the official docs' claimed default of 40.

Applies to: `~1surveyQuestions/get`

## Observed exchange

_One over the maximum. The refusal itself is where the true bounds come from._

```http
GET /surveyQuestions?%24top=201

→ 400
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
      "text": "'$top' must be less than or equal to the maximum result size for this end point: 200",
      "properties": [
        "$top"
      ],
      "hint": "If no '$top' parameter is specified, a default top size of 50 will be used."
    }
  ]
}
```

_Zero is out of range on the other side._

```http
GET /surveyQuestions?%24top=0

→ 400
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "INVALID_PARAMETER",
      "text": "'$top' must be greater than '0'.",
      "properties": [
        "$top"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
